label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 24
title: Dashboard build depends on backend changes first - dual backlog tracking (backend + dashboard)
body: For every dashboard capability that requires a backend change, a linked item exists in BOTH the product_forge backlog (backend change/design) and this dashboard backlog (UI/consumption), cross-linked by id. Backend work is a prerequisite and must complete before the dashboard item. This item tracks the convention itself; individual backend items are created as design reveals them.
